video_title: Stephen Curry Is Going Down With the Warriors Ship

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' contract negotiations with Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.excerpt: there's this looming discussion with Karl-Anthony Towns that they tabled the extension talks for him
quotes.quote: I want to start with the champs here. Knicks, obviously one of the most historic finals runs the last handful of years, haven't won a title in over 50 years. Brought back the team, mostly minus Mitchell Robinson, he's with Boston now. But there's this looming discussion with Karl-Anthony Towns that they tabled the extension talks for him. It's reported he got a 4 and 200 offer to him, but he can make 4 and 276. So a difference of 76 million dollars there. Josh Hart's another player that's up after this year, they got a team option on him, so they could stretch that out. Do you think this contract negotiation stuff is going to affect the Knicks in any way?

quotes.speaker: Matt Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' championship expectations and contract negotiations
quotes.excerpt: in professional sports the hardest thing to do is repeat, because there's so much more distractions
quotes.quote: I don't think the negotiations will help, but I think in professional sports the hardest thing to do is repeat, because there's so much more distractions. Obviously, Knicks fans are going to be expecting what they always expect, but they actually finally got it, which was a championship. So now it's championship or bust. Really interesting to see. Brunson set the bar with taking less. Now is Karl-Anthony Towns going to do the same? It looks like Josh Hart will have to do the same too. How much do players sacrifice financial gain to keep something good together? I think it's smart to table the conversations because that's just a distraction of the season. All this new extension stuff during the season is fairly new. Back in the day, you played your contract out and when it was up, you discussed your negotiations. So with all that said, congratulations to them, congratulations to coach Thibodeau, but now the target's on their back.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard's trade to the Raptors and Clippers' penalties
quotes.excerpt: Kawhi Leonard, but he dodged that and he's going to Toronto, that trade went through
quotes.quote: Speaking of someone that had a target on their back, Kawhi Leonard, but he dodged that and he's going to Toronto, that trade went through. He got an extension, 2 for 115. So just curious just what you think just about what happened with the Clippers and all that and him only really getting a 700,000 dollar fine, Uncle Dennis is banned from the NBA for five years. But Kawhi got really doesn't have to sit in the shit really with the Clippers anymore and he's on the Raptors who have a pretty decent team and I'm curious what you think of them as well.

quotes.speaker: Matt Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard's impact on the Clippers franchise
quotes.excerpt: if you bring Paul George in the mix, set that franchise back 5, 5 for sure
quotes.quote: Huge Kawhi Leonard fan, but that whole Kawhi experience, if you bring Paul George in the mix, set that franchise back 5, 5 for sure, but 10 if you really think about it. They lose first-round picks, got people suspended, Lawrence Frank is a snitch. Just a lot of different shit going on over there, but Kawhi came out unscathed. You know, to only have to pay a 700,000 dollar fine, but also want to preface it this way, this is not actually the first team that's brought to our attention, this happens often. I don't know to this extent and this level and many different businesses involved, but there's a lot of under the table handshakes and deals and not only basketball, in professional sports as a whole.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Historical context of NBA team penalties
quotes.excerpt: The last person to kind of do this at that level that a team got punished for
quotes.quote: The last person to kind of do this at that level that a team got punished for was in 2000 with the Timberwolves with Joe Smith. Yeah, and Glen Taylor got banned and but this obviously with inflation and everything, this was kind of the biggest one.

quotes.speaker: Matt Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: 76ers' potential with LeBron James and Jalen Brown
quotes.excerpt: A team that's fully loaded is the 76ers. LeBron James there, Jalen Brown goes there
quotes.quote: A team that's fully loaded is the 76ers. LeBron James there, Jalen Brown goes there. They played the Celtics the other night. LeBron living in New York, getting a helicopter back and forth. Shout out to Fanatics. I don't know how that works, but he has a deal with Fanatics and that's part of the offering, so it's all transparent and it's all on the up and up. But obviously, we know he's a big 76ers fan. I'm buying the 76ers. Obviously Joel Embiid hasn't looked very strong in the preseason, but that's what the preseason is for, to shake out the kinks. But I just love this team. I think the whole thing rides on Embiid. He's coming back at 250, which he was his rookie year, but this is a grown man 250, strong, slimmed down.

quotes.speaker: Matt Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' role and team expectations for the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: LeBron I think will be the one that orchestrates everything
quotes.quote: LeBron I think will be the one that orchestrates everything. There's talks in the off season about him running a lot of point forward, but I think he's the perfect distributor. You put him in the same position as you put Draymond Green, he's going to be incredible with a ton of different weapons. Edge is looking to have a big year. Jalen Brown is a monster. Tyrese Maxey, I saw him in New York just the other day and he's bigger than I realized and he's one of the best point guards in the game. So they got some depth coming off the bench. Nick Nurse, my guy Rico Hines over there, I'm really looking forward to what this team is able to do. I for sure think they're a top two, maybe three, could be the number one team in the East.

quotes.speaker: Matt Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' leadership impact on Joel Embiid
quotes.excerpt: LeBron is going to drop a lot of leadership wisdom on Embiid
quotes.quote: I think LeBron is going to drop a lot of leadership wisdom on Embiid because obviously this is Embiid's team still. So you heard in the past maybe not there as when it comes to leadership, but I think that's one thing LeBron will definitely bring to this team is the off the court guidance, leadership, and representation of how superstars are supposed to move.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's mindset after being traded to the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: I think Jalen Brown is a very smart guy and smart enough to know just go out there and kill
quotes.quote: If you're Jalen Brown, how are you supposed to feel? Because you were pretty vocal about, hey, I led the Celtics to the two seed, you know, I'm a number one guy, I want my own team and then he gets traded and now he's with Brown. So he really can't be that guy. I think Jalen Brown is a very smart guy and smart enough to know just go out there and kill, pretty much. Go out there and play. Fuck with what you need to talk, just go out there and let your play do it and he's always done that. He's always, his play has always showed up. You never want your words to start meaning or carrying more weight than your play, but Jalen Brown is someone who has gone out on the court and done what he's supposed to do.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Curry's contract extension and Warriors' future
quotes.excerpt: Steph just signed a two-year extension, took a little haircut, about 20 million less
quotes.quote: So the Warriors and just kind of Steph's legacy at large. Steph just signed a two-year extension, took a little haircut, about 20 million less than he could have got to give the team some flexibility. But Draymond Green, you see his deal? Made over 100 million dollars.

quotes.speaker: Matt Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Curry's commitment to the Warriors
quotes.excerpt: I feel like Steph's not going nowhere, I think Steph is going to be on that Kobe
quotes.quote: I feel like Steph's not going nowhere, I think Steph is going to be on that Kobe, you know, ride the ship till it sinks type situation. Extension where he took less money to hopefully give the team some flexibility.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaxon Hayes' development and potential with the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: Jaxon, is that how you say his name? Yeah. Fucking killer, big kid, not afraid of the moment
quotes.quote: I like Jaxon, is that how you say his name? Yeah. Fucking killer, big kid, not afraid of the moment, a shit talker. He made a post today with a picture of him giving Draymond a high five and he called him like granddaddy or something. So not afraid of the moment, big shit talker. One of those kids that stayed in college, I think he's 23 or 24 now as a rookie, so he's ready to go. I really like him.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Jackson's NBA scoring champion prediction
quotes.excerpt: I think there's three guys that jump out to me, one is skinny Luka
quotes.quote: I think there's three guys that jump out to me, one is skinny Luka. He looks like he's in great shape and this is his team now. I think that offense is going to play faster and obviously much more through him. So I think Luka is right there in the mix, obviously SGA is going to be right there in the mix. And then Anthony Edwards. I'm excited. I think Minnesota is a must watch team and I think adding LaMelo is going to take a ton of pressure off Ant to have to do everything because normally he has to make the plays, score, shoot, dunk, all that shit. I think LaMelo is going to take a ton of pressure off them.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Jackson's pick for NBA scoring champion
quotes.excerpt: I'm a keep it West Coast, I'm a keep it LA, I think Luka will win
quotes.quote: I'm a keep it West Coast, I'm a keep it LA, I think Luka will win the scoring title this year.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Jackson's pick for NBA assist champion
quotes.excerpt: I'm excited to see Trae Young play this year because I think he's taking a lot of heat
quotes.quote: In a league where true point guards aren't necessarily valued or even in the NBA anymore, I'm excited to see Trae Young play this year because I think he's taking a lot of heat and disrespect since he's been hurt. He's a 25 and 10 guy across his career. So he's going to be a killer and in to your point with a ton of talent, Anthony Davis, if he's able to stay healthy and stay there, we love AJ. So Trae is going to have a field day, not only scoring but distributing the ball. Jokic is someone who always makes the game fun and is almost a pass first 25, 26 a point score game.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Jackson's final prediction for assist leader
quotes.excerpt: I'm going to go Trae Young will lead the league in assists this year
quotes.quote: I'm going to go Trae Young will lead the league in assists this year.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Duren's mental state and performance expectations
quotes.excerpt: we're going to see what his mental's like. You know, when you first hear regardless to what he
quotes.quote: I think we're going to see what his mental's like. You know, when you first hear regardless to what he think he should have got, he didn't show up in the playoffs last year and I don't think that was a secret and I think that was a leading reason why they didn't give him what he thought he was going to make. But what's his mental like? He still got 200 million. He's still a very talented player. What is he going to come out and pout this year or is he going to come out and like show these motherfuckers that hey I should be making more money? But the only way we're really going to see that is come playoff time.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Houston Rockets' potential with Fred VanVleet
quotes.excerpt: Fred VanVleet, his veteran leadership, his wittiness, his ability to hit big shots
quotes.quote: Houston, I've been saying since last year I want to see what they did with a real point guard. I think Amen Thompson did a great job of trying to be a point forward, that's not his position, but I think that helped him grow as a player, but Fred VanVleet, his veteran leadership, his wittiness, his ability to hit big shots, his ability to lead from the point position puts Kevin Durant and Sengun back in their position where they don't have to bring the ball up and initiate the offense, he's going to be able to get them the ball. So I'm really high on what Fred can bring to Houston.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Reed Sheppard's role and potential with the Rockets
quotes.excerpt: I've always liked him and I think them trying to make him a point guard
quotes.quote: I've always liked him and I think them trying to make him a point guard, you know, he played well but he's not, he's someone that puts the ball in the basket. So I think you're able to slide him back to a smaller two. But I love Marcus Smart, his toughness, his veteran leadership, he's a winner everywhere he goes, so I'm excited. I'm excited to see this Houston team, particularly allowing Kevin Durant to slide back in his natural position and catch the ball where he's most effective. Sengun doesn't have to try to be a center point, you know, he's not a Jokic and I think sometimes he almost had to be that because they didn't really have a point guard.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Milwaukee Bucks' potential with Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.excerpt: I want to see what Miami does with Giannis, because he's unstoppable downhill
quotes.quote: I want to see what Miami does with Giannis, because he's unstoppable downhill, you know, Bam's ability to continue to get better and stretch the floor to give Giannis some more space. They've surrounded those guys with shooters with Tim Hardaway and Clay Thompson. So interesting to see what what Miami does.
